from pathlib import Path
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlparse
import hashlib, json, re
source = 'https://nlnet.nl/news/2026/20261103-call.html'
p = Path('products/services/nlnet-open-call-fit/raw/current-call.html')
raw = p.read_bytes()
digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
assert digest == '05c33b306cfdf655ce82a725079bf57734d97303f8f85a958ad2bf98c6155d1b'
class Extract(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.blocks = []
        self.parts = []
        self.links = []
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag == 'a':
            href = dict(attrs).get('href', '')
            url = urljoin(source, href)
            if href and urlparse(url).hostname == 'nlnet.nl' and url != source:
                self.links.append(url)
    def handle_data(self, text):
        self.parts.append(text)
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag in {'p', 'li', 'h1', 'h2', 'h3'}:
            self.blocks.append(' '.join(''.join(self.parts).split()))
            self.parts.clear()
parser = Extract()
parser.feed(raw.decode('utf-8'))
pattern = r'deadline|eligib|applican|licen[cs]|milestone|payment|reimburs|artificial intelligence|autonomous|propos|grant'
result = {'source':source,'sha256':digest,'scope':'Text and links extracted from the saved call only. Missing terms require verification against applicable first-party documents.','passages':[b for b in parser.blocks if re.search(pattern,b,re.I)][:30],'first_party_links':list(dict.fromkeys(parser.links))}
out = p.parent.parent / 'current-call-terms-pointers.json'
out.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'artifact':str(out),'sha256':digest,'matched_passages':len(result['passages']),'links':len(result['first_party_links'])}))
